description: The options model. Every enhancement the game ships is declared here once: settings key, default, maturity, what it interacts with, rollback, whether it changes the picture the player sees, and where it appears in the menu. docs/OPTIONS.md's table is generated from this file; tools/options_model.py checks it against the code (settings_load/settings_save, the bug-report display list, the menu), the README's experimental list and the golden corpus.

experimental.meaning: Opt-in, off by default, labelled in the README and the menu. It may change or be removed between versions.
entry: The option is declared here with default 0 and appears in the README's experimental list and in the in-game/Windows menu.
A rollback exists (set it back to 0) and is recorded in this file.
Its state is captured in bug reports (report_display) when it can change the picture.
exit: Its effect is covered by an automated or recorded check on a GL-capable machine (DQIX_GL_DUMP or a window screenshot) for the golden corpus cases it touches.
It changed no frame CRC of any golden case it must not affect (identity where the CRC is in scope).
No open bug against it for one full cycle of nightly use, with the known gaps below unchanged or closed.
It has a stable default story: promoting it is a one-line edit of default + maturity here, with the README list updated in the same PR.
experimental.known_gaps: No per-option window screenshots in CI yet (no GL in the automated environment): the visual half of the exit bar is run by hand on a GL machine.

beta.meaning: On by default where it makes sense, with documented gaps. Rollback is tested.
entry: Promoted from experimental by meeting the experimental exit criteria.
Its default is either 0 with a menu item that explains it, or 1 where the README says so.
Known gaps are listed in docs/OPTIONS.md and the README's notes.
exit: A golden-corpus case exercises it (directly or through a matrix cell).
No known conflict in the interaction matrix.
Its measured cost (frame time, memory) is recorded in docs/PERF.md or MILESTONES.md.
beta.known_gaps: Beta options whose effect is post-composition are golden-checked only for identity (crc_equal_postprocess).

stable.meaning: On by default, golden-checked, no known conflicts.
entry: Promoted from beta by meeting the beta exit criteria.
Covered by at least one golden case or matrix cell.
Rollback documented here and reversible from settings.ini alone.
stable.exit: A regression demotes it to beta in the same PR that records the regression in MILESTONES.md.

experimental_decisions.why: Its effect is drawn by the GL letter pass, which this cycle could not run (no display/OpenGL). Promoting on no evidence would make "beta" meaningless.
exit_criteria: Capture the corpus's HD-text cases with DQIX_GL_DUMP on a GL machine and record the shadows' presence.
Confirm the HD-text corpus CRCs stay identical with the option on (they currently do, crc_equal_postprocess).
One nightly cycle with no shadow/outline defect reported.

experimental_decisions.why: A post-composition artistic effect with no reference frame to compare against; its cost is a GL pass whose timing was not measured on a GL machine.
exit_criteria: Window screenshots (before/after) on a GL machine for a field and a battle frame.
Frame-time cost measured and recorded in docs/PERF.md.
No frame CRC drift with the option on.

experimental_decisions.why: Its output depends on the player's texture packs, so a corpus run without packs says nothing about it; the xBR pass is a known one-off cost at load.
exit_criteria: A corpus case that runs with a small bundled pack and records load time and memory.
GL capture showing the upscaled result on a road/battle texture.
No crash or leak across a full session with packs on.

experimental_decisions.why: It infers battle panels from the bottom screen's pixels; a non-battle window with the same lines could be misread. The golden corpus has battles but no GL window capture of the HUD.
exit_criteria: Wide-layout window capture of a battle with and without the HUD (DQIX_WINSHOT_AT).
An audit of non-battle frames where the detector fires (false positives recorded).
The battle corpus CRCs stay identical with the option on.

experimental_decisions.decision: keep the value experimental, inside a stable option
experimental_decisions.why: Dynamic Widescreen moves the game's own windows; it is exercised by the corpus (identity of the DS picture) but its window composition is only visible on a GL machine.
exit_criteria: Window captures of a field, a menu and a battle in wide_dynamic.
No CRC drift against the non-dynamic wide case.
One nightly cycle without a layout report.

non_enhancement_keys.resolution_3d: Legacy alias of render_scale, read for settings files from before v29.
non_enhancement_keys.small_screen_opacity_chosen: Bookkeeping so a saved 100% opacity is not mistaken for the old default.
non_enhancement_keys.console_color_chosen: Bookkeeping so the default skin is not read as a player choice.
non_enhancement_keys.volume: Audio level, not an enhancement of the picture.
non_enhancement_keys.discord_app_id: Discord application id override for developers.
non_enhancement_keys.wireless_mac: This copy's identity on the network.
non_enhancement_keys.session_consoles: How friends' consoles run on this PC.
